definition: Hugging Face Transformers is an open-source deep learning library developed by Hugging Face.
details: It provides implementations of pretrained transformer and other neural network models for training and inference, including models for text, images, audio, video, and multimodal learning.

explainer.lead: How to install Hugging Face Transformers, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Hugging Face (Thomas Wolf, Lysandre Debut, Julien Chaumond and team), first released in 2018 as pytorch-pretrained-bert.

quickstart.python:
from transformers import pipeline

classify = pipeline("sentiment-analysis")
print(classify("This dictionary is really helpful!"))

chat = pipeline("text-generation", model="Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct")
print(chat([{"role": "user", "content": "Explain attention in one line."}], max_new_tokens=40))

explainer.inAi: Download, run and fine-tune thousands of open models from the Hugging Face Hub. Transformers.js runs many of them in the browser or Node via ONNX Runtime, with no server.
